title: Checkpoint: multiplication table
prompt:
Implement `String timesTable(int n)`: return `n` lines; line `k` (1-based) contains the products k*1, k*2, ..., k*n separated by single spaces, and ends with `
`. `timesTable(3)` starts "1 2 3
2 4 6
3 6 9
".

tests.name: table rows
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.timesTable(1), "1
", "1x1");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.timesTable(3), "1 2 3
2 4 6
3 6 9
", "3 rows");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.timesTable(2), "1 2
2 4
", "2 rows symmetric check");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.timesTable(4), "1 2 3 4
2 4 6 8
3 6 9 12
4 8 12 16
", "4 rows asymmetric");
tests.hint: Outer loop picks the row k; inner loop builds k*1..k*n with spaces between.
